definitions.explanation: An effort to do something new or challenging, often with an element of uncertainty about the outcome. Implies a deliberate, thoughtful undertaking rather than a casual try.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{試|こころ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{試|こころ}み⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}する→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧わからない。
examples.english: I don't know if that attempt will succeed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活性化|かっせいか}→活性化：07563_kasseika⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けた→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧{試|こころ}み⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、マルシェ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}した→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧。
examples.english: As an initiative to revitalize the region, a marché was held.

notes:
USAGE:
{試|こころ}み is the noun form of the verb {試|こころ}みる (to try, to attempt). It has a more thoughtful and deliberate nuance than the casual ⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}→挑戦：03495_chousen⟧ (challenge). It often appears in news, essays, and formal discussions about innovative projects or experiments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{試|こころ}み: a new attempt/initiative
- {試|こころ}み⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: as an experiment/trial
- ⟦{大胆|だいたん}→大胆：07609_daitan⟧な{試|こころ}み: a bold attempt
- {試|こころ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実|みの}る→実る：00282_minoru⟧: an attempt bears fruit
- ⟦{画期的|かっきてき}→画期的：06826_kakkiteki⟧な{試|こころ}み: a groundbreaking initiative

SIMILAR WORDS:
{試|こころ}み emphasizes deliberate experimentation. ⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}→挑戦：03495_chousen⟧ (challenge) implies taking on something difficult with a competitive spirit. {試行|しこう} (trial run) is more technical and procedural.
